content:
sam: Heads-up — PR #14321 is stuck on the CI gate, only failing on linux-integ-gpu shard 7. Can someone give quick eyes so I can either rerun or update the snapshot?

ci-bot: buildkite: #8765 — linux-integ-gpu/shard7 — FAILED — tests/cli/kv_persist_test.go:142
ci-bot: Failure: image mismatch for TestKVPersistence after commit 1f9a3b2

kevin: Can you paste the failing diff or tail of the log?

sam: Pasting the relevant snippet below:
```
--- expected.png
+++ actual.png
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
  …
 - green bar at x=120
 + green bar at x=121

 command: ./bin/test-runner --shard=7 --filter TestKVPersistence
 exit code: 1
```

nina: Hm — that single-pixel shift smells like nondeterministic rendering in the headless renderer, not a real behavior regression. Could be timing/jitter on GPU nodes. Do we want a targeted rerun first or go straight to snapshot update?

sam: I'd prefer a targeted rerun once. Policy is we need one reviewer approval to trigger a targeted CI rerun for merge-blocking failures. @kevin can you approve a rerun?

kevin: Approved for rerun. :thumbsup:

sam: Thanks — kicking off a targeted rerun on just linux-integ-gpu/shard7 now. I'll report back in this thread.

ci-bot: Scheduled: targeted rerun (only shard7) for build #8765 — queued on gpu-pool-3.

olivia: If it flakes again, we should open a flake-quarantine ticket and consider skipping the test for the current merge window. Also file a follow-up issue to investigate the renderer nondeterminism.

sam: Agreed. If the rerun passes I'll merge, otherwise I'll open the ticket and ping infra. Thanks all for the quick turnaround.
